decision_description: Phase 2 concept alignment completed for MSCA-PF proposal targeting HORIZON-MSCA-2026-PF-01-01. The research methodology core — uncertainty-aware multi-sensor diagnosis and economically optimised irrigation decision support for row crops — is aligned with MSCA-PF call scope at the research excellence level: EO-07 (R&I capacity and knowledge transfer) is Inferred from confirmed Tier 3 sources; SR-01 research dimension is partially covered. Strategic differentiation is documented as the single empty-cell gap claim in the systematic literature review matrix (Real-Time Decision Support × PlanetScope) and the two-route risk-hedged architecture (Route A: Direct Probabilistic Fusion; Route B: Homogeneous Patch Proxy sharing one downstream decision engine). Six of eight MSCA-PF expected outcomes (EO-01, EO-02, EO-03, EO-04, EO-05, EO-06, EO-08) carry Assumed status because the researcher, supervisor, and host identity spine is entirely Unresolved — no fellow, supervisor, or host organisation is named in any Tier 3 source. Four unresolved scope conflicts are recorded in concept_refinement_summary.json scope_conflict_log: SCL-01 (SR-02 EF geographic placement unassessable — fellowship type and host country both Unresolved); SCL-02 (SR-05 / CC-10 Career Development Plan mandatory deliverable absent — supervisor Unresolved); SCL-03 (CC-01 joint application by identified researcher and beneficiary unaddressed — both researcher and host Unresolved); SCL-04 (systemic coverage gap for six MSCA-PF researcher/host expected outcomes — blocked by absence of identity spine). The concept alignment proceeds on the 24-month European Fellowship working scaffold (Assumed, not Confirmed) per the honest-block posture (D17 per MILESTONE1_DECISION_RECORD.md). No scope conflict is silently resolved; all four unresolved conflicts are explicitly documented and must be addressed when the identity spine is confirmed or operator-declared via confirmation_checklist.json.
alternatives_considered: Fabricate or infer researcher, supervisor, and host identity to enable full Confirmed coverage of all eight expected outcomes — rejected as a constitutional violation per CLAUDE.md §13.3 (no fabricated project facts) and §13.8 (no finalising text when source state is known to be incomplete).

Treat the spine-dependent unresolved scope conflicts as a Phase 2 gate failure and halt entirely — considered but rejected because the research methodology corpus is substantively aligned with MSCA-PF call scope at the research level (EO-07 Inferred; SR-01 research dimension partially covered; strategic differentiation documented); the four unresolved conflicts are spine-dependent rather than methodology-dependent; halting Phase 2 would prevent progress on all research-grounded sections while the spine is awaited, producing no benefit over the documented honest-block posture.

Adopt a Global Fellowship scaffold rather than the 24-month European Fellowship scaffold — not elected because the fellowship_type is Unresolved and a GF scaffold would additionally require nationality confirmation under CC-11, a named non-associated Third Country partner, a 36-month total duration, and a mandatory 12-month return phase structure; the EF scaffold is the lower-commitment default consistent with the working_scaffold_months=24 value in project_summary.json duration_status.

Log EO-07 as Assumed rather than Inferred — rejected because concept_note.md and strategic_positioning.md provide a traceable inference chain (novel probabilistic-fusion framework as R&I output; 'two-way transfer of knowledge' named in section 1.3; 'defensible probabilistic-fusion decision framework where the literature is thin' in section 2.3) that satisfies the Inferred status definition under CLAUDE.md §12.2.
tier_authority_applied: CLAUDE.md §7 Phase 2 gate condition (concept note vocabulary aligned with call-specific expected outcomes; strategic positioning identifies differentiation within call scope); Tier 2B expected_outcomes.json (docs/tier2b_topic_and_call_sources/extracted/expected_outcomes.json); Tier 2B scope_requirements.json (docs/tier2b_topic_and_call_sources/extracted/scope_requirements.json); Tier 2B call_constraints.json (docs/tier2b_topic_and_call_sources/extracted/call_constraints.json); Tier 3 project_summary.json (docs/tier3_project_instantiation/project_brief/project_summary.json); CLAUDE.md §12.2 (validation status categories: Confirmed, Inferred, Assumed, Unresolved); CLAUDE.md §13.3 and §13.8 (no fabricated project facts; no finalising text when source state is known to be incomplete)
rationale: The Phase 2 gate condition under CLAUDE.md §7 requires: (1) topic mapping confirmed; (2) concept note vocabulary aligned with call-specific expected outcomes; (3) strategic positioning identifies differentiation within call scope; (4) no unresolved scope conflicts remain between concept and Tier 2B. Conditions (1), (2), and (3) are satisfied: topic_mapping.json is written to Tier 3 with all eight expected outcomes assessed; EO-07 vocabulary alignment is Inferred from named Tier 3 sources; strategic differentiation via the gap-matrix single-empty-cell claim and two-route risk-hedged architecture is documented in concept_refinement_summary.json. Condition (4) is not fully satisfied: SCL-01 through SCL-04 are unresolved. However, all four conflicts are spine-dependent — they cannot be resolved from Tier 2B and Tier 3 sources because the Tier 3 identity spine (fellow, supervisor, host) is absent per the honest-block posture (D17). The research methodology is not in scope conflict with Tier 2B; MSCA-PF scope_requirements.json imposes no thematic or methodological restrictions on research domain. CLAUDE.md §12.4 requires missing mandatory inputs to trigger a gate failure rather than papering over completion; §15 states that a declared failure is honest and correct while fabricated completion is a constitutional violation. The decision is to proceed with Phase 2 completion with explicit acknowledgement of all four unresolved conflicts and all six Assumed expected-outcome mappings in the phase output artifacts, block all spine-dependent Phase 8 sections until the identity spine is confirmed or operator-declared, and record this decision durably per CLAUDE.md §9.4 rather than holding it only in agent memory.
